_about: What a wild spot does now and then besides a fight, by the theme of its area (mine, 2026-11-01, from Robin's list: theme events). A share of max HP or mana, gold by the tier, a flask or a card; the text is what the player reads.

meadow.text: A quiet picnic spot in the sun: you rest a while.

forest.text: Brambles snag you on the way through.

fire.text: A crack in the ground spits lava: you jump, not quite in time.

water.text: The tide leaves a drowned purse on the shingle.

swamp.text: A will-o'-the-wisp leads you to a lost flask.

desert.text: An oasis: water, shade, and a moment's peace.

crystal.text: The crystals hum: your mind clears.

shadow.text: Something in the dark drinks your strength.

sky.text: A storm rolls in and throws your die about.
